title: Dubai DLD Project Construction Database
license: CC BY 4.0, as stated by the republisher for this dataset
attribution: Continental Club Property, based on Dubai Land Department project registry data. Dataset "Dubai DLD Project Construction Database", snapshot of 1 November 2026. https://continentalclub.ae/data/project-status.csv
v48IdentityCrosswalk: 67 reviewed one-to-one links in reviewed-v48-crosswalk.json; 3,804 source IDs remain unmatched. Fifteen JVC links use DLD area-code 681 evidence. Another 29 specific project identities are corroborated by the Emaar South and Nshama Town Square project pages, without inferring blanket district equivalence.
limits: This is a dated CC BY 4.0 republished DLD register snapshot, not a live DLD API or an all-UAE census. Percentages are the last recorded technical inspection and may be stale; handover dates are declared, not actual. Sixty-seven reviewed V48 identity links do not supply geometry, sales, prices, or new project-pin coordinates, and do not revise V48 status or timelines.
